en: "I see. Quite the power of deduction you have.{w}...Just so. It was not this Cerberus that killed him."{w}
"Heh heh heh..."{w}
By the time you realized something was wrong, your way out had already been cut off.{w}
"He was the Summoner in my party.{w}But at some point, he had a change of heart, you see... and turned to the Good alignment."{w}
note: Zen no kairitsu = Good alignment (Wizardry-style Good/Neutral/Evil). 'He' = the dead adventurer; the source says kare.

en: "We are those who walk the path of evil.{w}When one of us half-heartedly awakens to the likes of justice, it causes us no end of trouble."{w}
note: Accuracy: chuutohanpa ni modifies the awakening (half-hearted), not distance; meraretewa = when one of us goes and does it. | Editorial: "makes things no end of trouble" is not idiomatic; nanzo (dismissive) as "the likes of".

en: "He could have just left without a word, but instead he started getting in our way.{w}So we called him out into this forest."{w}{p}"Honestly, summoning a Cerberus of all things... he just would not go quietly.{w}Thanks to that, I came out of it badly hurt."{w}
note: kocchi wa daikega: rendered 'I' because the next row shows the Mage's own bandaged arm; could also be 'we'.

en: The mage rolled up a sleeve, revealing an arm wrapped in bandages.{w}
"Now then. If we are telling you all this, you already know what that means, don't you?"{w}
Having made sure they were dead, the Cerberus let a lonely howl ring out through the forest.{w}
note: 'they' = the three Suspicious adventurers just defeated.

en: Then, gently taking its master's body in its jaws, it turned its back on you and went off somewhere.{w}
"Nnnooooo---!?{w}Is one little fairy gonna drop dead out here in the middle of nowhere!?{w}No-o, I don't want that, I don't waaaaant iiit!!"{w}
note: noTarejini = die a dog's death by the wayside.

en: ...Lunea is making a racket.{w}
"Huh? Huh-huh-huh-huh!?{w}Whaaaat!! Ev-evewybodyyyyy!!"{w}
note: minashaaan: Lunea's panicked lisp of minasan; kept as a stretched cry rather than a lisp. | Editorial: lisp kept here too (minashaan), to match "hewp" in 2906 (same panic, same tic).

en: "H-hewp me, hewp meeee!!"{w}
note: tashukete = lisped tasukete; rendered as 'hewp'.

en: "Gnyoooooooh!?{w}You won't let me join your party!?{w}N-no wayyy!!"{w}
"I'll hold a grudge against youuu~{w}I'll resent you for the rest of my liiife!!{w}Waaaaah!!"{w}
Lunea leapt onto you.{w}
note: tobitsuite kita = jumped on / clung to you (joining).

en: Certain NPCs join your adventure in the summoned monster slot.{w}{p}If you already have an NPC like this with you, you cannot bring another one along.{w}{p}Either finish the event of the NPC currently with you, or temporarily disband your party at the tavern.{w}
note: System tutorial text. sakaba = the tavern (generic, not named). | Editorial: "disband your party once" read as "one time"; ichido = disband for now and re-form.

en: The indescribable scent of catnip water hangs in the air.{w}
Take the catnip water?

[Key Item]
You obtained Catnip Water.{w}
note: Glossary: matatabi-sui = catnip water; capitalized here as the key item name. Align with the item table.

en: Fairy
"Beyond here is where we fairies live!{w}We're not letting the likes of you climb up there~"{w}
note: Editorial: "our home, the fairies' home" was a clumsy apposition for bokutachi fearii no ie.

en: Try giving them something?
"Whoa, you're giving us that!?{w}...Then just this once, I'll pretend I didn't see you! Go on through!"{w}
"What is this!? Like anyone could eat this stuff!!"{w}
You were turned away.{w}
Bard

"You should be able to start the climb from that entrance right there, but..."{w}{p}"The fairies over there just won't let anyone through, you know?{w}Isn't there something that might put them in a good mood?"{w}
note: Accuracy: nai desu ka ne is an open musing/hint, not a direct question about what the party carries.

en: A man is surrounded by fairies.{w}
note: Source says hitori no otoko ('a man'), and the speaker who follows is the Principal: script evidence for the Principal's gender (glossary has unknown).

en: "Now, now, let's all just calm dooown a little, shall we~?{w}I'm simply here, as the Principal of Rubenburg, you seeee..."{w}
"This one's still got more!"{w}
"All of it!{w}Leave every last bit of it behind!"{w}
"You can have them, you can have them, reeeally~{w}I'd just be so honored if you would come and teach at our school..."{w}
"Found it! Found some in a pocket!{w}Cookies! Sweet buns! Biscuits!"{w}
"Pluck away~!!"{w}
note: mushire = pluck/strip (no object in the source).

en: "Snort!?{w}E-everyone, no roughhousing...{w}I'd really like you to stooop, you knooow!?"{w}
note: buhi'= the Principal's pig snort; 'Snort' as in slice 026.

en: After the commotion, the Principal lay collapsed, completely spent.{w}

"Well, well, getting along with the fairy folk sure is tricky~"{w}{p}"But I won't be discouraged, nooo~{w}If I can just invite the fairy folk over, I'm sure our school's lessons will be all the richer for it~"{w}{p}"A little while ago, over that way, you seeee, I found a lovely spring~{w}Rest there a while, and any wounds should heal, too."{w}{p}"And then, to negotiate with the fairy folk, I'll go buy some new sweets again!{w}Snort-ho-ho-ho!!"{w}
note: Whose wounds heal is left open (source: kizu mo ieru deshou).

en: Earth Elemental
"What's the matter, adventurers?{w}Lookin' for somethin', are you?"{w}
note: Folksy old-man speech (washi, oru, ee).

en: Looking for something?
"Hmm, old sheet music, you say?{w}Can't say I know of it..."{w}{p}"Have you asked my fellow over on that floating cloud?{w}If not, go on and see.{w}...Up you go!!"{w}
note: sora' = shout as the Elemental launches the party on the wind (next row).

en: You rode the wind and flew up into the air!{w}
"Well, stay a while and take it easy."{w}
"Ho ho ho.{w}So adventurers have made it all the way up here, eh?{w}Well, stay a while and take it easy."{w}
Wind Elemental

"...Old sheet music, you say?{w}Hmm... so it seems you are not just wandering about for no reason."{w}{p}"Very well. One who knows of it is on the cloud over there.{w}I could send you there. What will you do?"{w}
Ask to be sent over?
note: Editorial: "Have it send you over?" read oddly as a choice; agentless form avoids "it" (accuracy suggestion).

en: "Then go..."{w}
"Well, suit yourselves."{w}
"Since ancient times, mountains have been sacred ground.{w}All the more so here, the land of Omshokopo, the Wind Sage.{w}Do not go scurrying about needlessly."{w}
note: Omshokopo-sama: no title added (gender not established).

en: Fire Elemental
"Old sheet music?{w}That old thing? I threw it out!{w}...Just kidding!"{w}{p}"I know somebody who might know about it. Want me to introduce you?"{w}
Get an introduction?
"Then off you go!"{w}
"Hmph. Whatever."{w}
"This mountain is where all the spirits gather.{w}And on top of that, Omshokopo's up at the very summit!{w}Don't you go dumping trash or anything, got it?"{w}
Water Elemental
"Old sheet music... an old song...?{w}Ah, yes, there was such a thing, wasn't there."{w}
Is that your wish?
note: goshomou de? = 'You desire it?' (polite).

en: "Then, safe travels."{w}
"I see."{w}
"Water flows and changes.{w}It never takes the same shape twice. Every meeting comes only once.{w}And so, hello. And goodbye."{w}
note: ichigo ichie = each encounter happens only once in a lifetime.

en: Shining Figure
note: New name: kagayaku sugata.

en: "Omshokopo is the wisest of the Four Sages.{w}Take care not to show your foolishness and leave Omshokopo appalled."{w}
note: Name repeated instead of a pronoun (gender not established).

en: Earth Man
"Ohhh...{w}You want the old sheet music..."{w}{p}"Nowadays... in a thing like this...{w}hardly anyone... takes an interest...{w}Sing it... with care..."{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the ?First Movement.{w}
note: Item name provisional; leading '?' kept as in the source (cf. '?Ancient Song', slice 017).

en: "Ohhh...{w}My back hurts..."{w}
Sylphe

"Whaddya want?{w}Old sheet music? You mean this thing~?"{w}{p}"You want this ratty scrap of paper that bad?{w}Then hey! If I went fwoo~ and blew it way off into the sky, would you get mad? Would ya?"{w}{p}"..........{w}Fwoooooo~!!{w}Kidding, just kidding! Here, take it, take iiit!"{w}
note: Sylphe talks like a gal (a-shi, a-ni). okoru? okoru? = 'would you get mad? Would ya?'.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the ?Second Movement.{w}
note: Provisional item name.

en: "Hey hey!{w}Gonna blow some good winds your way today too~"{w}
Phoenix

"What is it? As you can see, I am already old.{w}My flame has dwindled; all that is left is to fade away..."{w}{p}"What, you say you are looking for sheet music?{w}You mean this. ...Folk from the world below seeking it now, after all this time? What has brought this on?"{w}{p}"Well, no matter.{w}If there are those who wish to know it, take it."{w}
note: dou iu kaze no fukimawashi = 'what brought this on'.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained the ?Third Movement.{w}
note: Provisional item name.

en: "What is it, whelp...{w}You surely have no more business with a worn-out old thing like me.{w}Now, go."{w}
note: kozou = 'kid/whelp', said to the party; rendered without gender.

en: Undine

"Old sheet music? Ah, yes, I do have some.{w}There are people who want to sing it these days?{w}Hmm..."{w}{p}"Well, if that's how it is, I'll give it to you.{w}Don't treat it carelessly, all right?"{w}
